deficiencies.description: The rewrite conflates two separate functions of the basement membrane mentioned in the lecture—providing signalling and providing a basis for cell adherence—into a single combined concept ('signalling basis').
deficiencies.sourcePassage: provides a signaling and basis for their adherence to this layer
deficiencies.rewritePassage: provides a signalling basis for their adherence to this layer
deficiencies.studentHarm: A student would learn that the basement membrane merely provides a basis for adherence that involves signalling, missing that it independently provides biochemical signalling as well as a physical basis for adherence.
